lines.text: Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem was greatly alarmed because Gibeon had made peace with Israel and was larger than Ai.
Adoni-zedek called four kings to help him, and five Amorite kings camped before Gibeon and made war against it.
Gibeon sent word to Joshua at Gilgal, and he marched all night from Gilgal and surprised the five kings.
The LORD threw the armies into darkness, and large hailstones from the sky killed more of them than Israel's swords did.
Joshua told the sun to stand still over Gibeon and the moon over the Valley of Aijalon, then returned to Gilgal.
